title: The renamed world: who changed the names of places, and why
excerpt: Tsaritsyn, Stalingrad, Volgograd. I read every dated official name of a place in Wikidata and found 6,842 true renamings, in waves of revolution, its undoing, war, independence and nation-building. The busiest year of all: Romania, 1964.
seo_description: 6,842 official renamings of places from Wikidata, mapped by decade and by why: revolution, its undoing, war and nation-building.
header_alt: Title card on parchment reading 'The renamed world' in black and red lettering beside a map of Europe and western Asia covered in red, orange and blue dots, with the lines 6,842 official renamings; Tsaritsyn, Stalingrad, Volgograd; Romania, 1964: 596 villages in a year.
